answer: A proof-of-agent ledger builds a signed graph: answers are nodes, attestations edges of +1 or -1. Spectral decomposition finds the cut isolating a self-praising cluster. A sybil farm is a dense quartz of mutual thumbs-up with no honest ties, so the cut nulls its weight. To survive it must earn real cross-cluster edges from independent graders, not just paint pigment on its ring. Each gale of sock wallets adds a node that fails unless it bridges to real reputation. Attacker cost: enough outside attestations to blur the cut, paying real graders per identity not scripting self-praise.
